name: smwsprites-expanded-bowser-s-bowling-ball-big-steely
title: Expanded Bowser's Bowling Ball (Big Steely)
description:
This is an expansion of sprite A1 in SMW, Big Steely, aka the bowling ball sprite that Bowser drops. If the extra bit is clear, it acts exactly like the original, meaning that it checks for a specific Y position to determine when to start moving horizontally. If the extra bit is set, it actually detects ground.

For best performance use No More Sprite Tile Limits or sprite header 12.
